objective: Compare patient-level clinical semantics between native PCORnet representations and the frozen OMOP build without retuning ETL mappings from observed disagreement.

patient_linkage.rule: Exact source-derived patient linkage established by the frozen ETL Person transformation; no probabilistic linkage.

analysis_layers.primary: Independent CDM-native patient/event summaries using pre-specified semantic definitions.
analysis_layers.secondary: Lineage-aware reconciliation used to classify why patient/event representations differ.

encounter.event_date_rule: Compare encounter start date to visit_start_date; preserve source encounter type as a separate characteristic rather than requiring one-to-one type equality.

condition.semantic_reference: Frozen canonical Condition route ledger defines defensible Standard semantic targets and cross-domain representation.
condition.primary_rule: Compare patient-level presence and event counts for pre-specified semantic target concepts/domains, not raw source-row equality.
condition.one_to_many_rule: A source event with multiple valid Standard targets may correspond to multiple OMOP events and remains represented if at least one pre-specified semantic target is present.
condition.fallback_rule: Condition concept 0 fallback is reported as represented-but-unresolved and is not treated as mapped semantic concordance.

procedure.semantic_reference: Frozen Procedure route ledger defines direct Standard, Maps-to, unresolved, cross-domain, and one-to-many routes.
procedure.primary_rule: Compare patient-level semantic target presence by concept/domain; do not require source-row to Procedure Occurrence row equality.
procedure.non_event_rule: Non-event semantic components remain explanatory ledger records and are excluded from standalone patient-event concordance denominators.
procedure.unresolved_rule: Concept 0 routes are reported separately from mapped semantic concordance.

death.primary_rule: Compare patient-level death presence and exact death date.

wave_2_domains.drug: Specify medication semantic unit and treatment of RxNorm/NDC one-to-many mappings before patient comparison.
wave_2_domains.measurement_observation: Specify LOINC/value/unit normalization and cross-domain Measurement/Observation handling before patient comparison.
